Hi Lindsay / Tom —

Great to speak with you today — appreciate the clarity on the security and regulatory constraints. Below is a short recap from Redwood + proposed next steps so we can get the technical deep‑dive scheduled with the right engineers.

Recap (what we heard):
- Goal: Deploy a private instance of Redwood in AcmeHealth’s VPC (us‑east‑1) for latency and data residency.
- Regulatory: HIPAA-bound data; encryption at rest and in transit required; audit logging and retention policy needed for 7 years.
- Air‑gap pilot: Two on‑prem hospital sites may require an air‑gapped variant — only allowed artifacts via signed bundle and a jump host for package refreshes.
- Networking: Egress limited; outbound requests must go through a company proxy/jump host; limited IP allowances to vendor control plane endpoints.

What Redwood provides / notes:
- Private mode: We support a private control plane that can be customer‑managed (we integrate with customer KMS or HSM for key wrapping).
- Air‑gapped option: We provide signed release bundles (OCI image + checksum + signature) and an upgrade tool that validates signatures before applying.
- Network doc: attached a first‑pass network & ports requirements PDF and our architecture diagram. These are starting points — we’ll tailor for your security team.

Open items / asks from AcmeHealth:
- Confirm whether AcmeHealth will manage the control plane or prefers Redwood to host in a private account.
- Provide IP ranges for the jump host / proxy we should allow in our packaging and update instructions.
- Share any specific KMS/HSM vendor details and procurement timelines.

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical deep‑dive (engineers): Tue 8 Jun, 10:00–11:30 PT — Camila, Rafael, Marissa from Redwood; Lindsay, Tom + infrastructure team from AcmeHealth. (Please confirm availability.)
2) Security questionnaire & SOC2 artifacts: Redwood to send a short evidence packet after the deep‑dive.
3) Draft mutual action plan (MAP) post‑deep‑dive with milestones for pilot setup, air‑gap validation, and SOC2 onboarding.

Attachments: acmehealth-network-reqs.pdf, redwood-private-arch-diagram.png

Thanks — I’ll loop in Rafael (our infra lead) on the deep‑dive so we can answer the KMS/air‑gap questions.

Best,
